fusions.name: Grabbing Leap
fusions.desc: You spring up to 5 tiles onto the target and clamp it, dealing 12 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Vice Grip
fusions.desc: A grip that deals 28 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lend a Grip
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Toe Pads
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
